messages.content: Independent enterprise release-risk reviewer. Review exact SHA 079caa6f209700d4cfafeda8c27c5a9b5522603a only. Fail only for a concrete unresolved material defect. Output schema JSON only.

Human-centered review UX release. Product changes are only planner/jobs UI and CSS; auth, repository, dependencies, Docker/Compose, deployment and trust code unchanged. The authorized Caballito is visible as a first-class native radio choice; mascot=true cannot display as Sin personaje. Pre-production review is six scannable cards with friendly labels, technical payload collapsed. Review asks approve vs change first; change textarea appears only after Quiero hacer cambios and Critic findings can seed it. Producer Red Team found two defects: custom role=radio keyboard semantics and stale pre-autosave Ease E2E. Fixer exact SHA uses native input type=radio with keyboard verification and updates verifier to shipped autosave contract. Exact evidence: full 172 tests/171 pass/0 fail/1 preexisting skip; typecheck/build PASS; contracts 13/13; audit clean; Ease/FIRMES/scene/generic browser E2E PASS; detached independent worktree 51/51 + typecheck/build/contracts/audit PASS; runtime 1481 files, 0 forbidden entries, 0 external symlinks.
